}}'''Andric''' was the King of [[Tarabon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Andric}}

== Appearance ==
His hair was graying.

== Activities ==
He first meets with [[Jaichim Carridin]] to help place his lover [[Amathera Aelfdene Casmir Lounault]] as the [[Panarch]].{{ref/book|4|38}} After the [[Seanchan]] take [[Amadicia]], [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath|High Lady Suroth]] tells [[Morgase Trakand|Morgase]] that when they took Tarabon, they killed the old king. He is therefore presumed dead.
